"""Author an isolated three-file delta. No product import or execution."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import copy
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import stat

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BASE = Path('/workspace/scratch/dda74a4fae35/v116-source-parser-r19-original/source-readback-r1/candidate-ci314')
PREPARED = Path('/workspace/scratch/dda74a4fae35/v116-union-r19/source')
BASE_TREE = 'd15d7a476fc3f711b2729236e84b7a9573da7a3d'
TARGETS = {
    'tools/check_hia_core_only.py': '1b976ae9334062d58daf445f4663daac339a9b0a',
    'tests/hia_linux_file_roundtrip_portable.py': '1c7521958d544f77aeb24b2c18f5dfb0e6b73d66',
}
NEW = 'tests/test_hia_roundtrip_source_roles.py'
ROLE_NAMES = (
    'DISCOVERY_FILES', 'NATIVE_SOURCE_FILES', 'SOURCE_BUILD_FILES',
    'COMPILER_BUILD_FILES', 'PUBLICATION_BUILD_FILES', 'BACKEND_BUILD_FILES',
    'EMITTER_BUILD_FILES', 'BYTE_WRAPPER_BUILD_FILES', 'MACHINE_OBJECT_BUILD_FILES',
    'EXECUTION_OBSERVATION_BUILD_FILES', 'CONTINUATION_BUILD_FILES', 'ENTRY_BUILD_FILES',
)
RELATED = (
    'tests/test_hia_core_only.py', 'tests/test_hia_source_suffix.py',
    'tests/test_hia_installed_fixture_resources.py', 'tests/test_hia_agent_installed_resources.py',
    'hepta/hia_agent_contract.py', 'hepta/hia_optional_profiles.py',
    'hepta/hia_linux_file_roundtrip.py', 'hepta/hia_agent_assembly.py', 'hepta/hia_program.py',
    'examples/hia_bootstrap/native_file_roundtrip.hepta',
)


def pin(raw, mode=0o644):
    return {'bytes': len(raw), 'mode': mode, 'git_mode': '100644',
            'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            'git_blob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest()}


def write(path, raw):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(raw)
    path.chmod(0o644)
    assert path.read_bytes() == raw


def dump(path, value):
    write(path, (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n').encode())


def single(text, old, new):
    assert text.count(old) == 1
    return text.replace(old, new, 1)


def parse(text):
    return ast.parse(text)


def dump_ast(node):
    return ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False)


def assignment(tree, name):
    found = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
             and len(n.targets) == 1 and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name) and n.targets[0].id == name]
    assert len(found) == 1, name
    return found[0]


def function(tree, name):
    found = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name]
    assert len(found) == 1, name
    return found[0]


def tree_id(manifest):
    root = {}
    for path, row in manifest.items():
        pieces = path.split('/')
        cursor = root
        for piece in pieces[:-1]:
            cursor = cursor.setdefault(piece, {})
        assert pieces[-1] not in cursor
        cursor[pieces[-1]] = (row['git_mode'], row['git_blob'])
    def calculate(node):
        entries = []
        for name, value in node.items():
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                mode, oid, key = '40000', calculate(value), name.encode() + b'/'
            else:
                mode, oid = value
                key = name.encode()
            entries.append((key, mode.encode() + b' ' + name.encode() + b'\0' + bytes.fromhex(oid)))
        raw = b''.join(value for _, value in sorted(entries))
        return hashlib.sha1(b'tree ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest()
    return calculate(root)


base_manifest = json.loads((BASE.parent / 'CANDIDATE-MANIFEST.json').read_bytes())
assert len(base_manifest) == 3175 and tree_id(base_manifest) == BASE_TREE
source = {}
for name, oid in TARGETS.items():
    path = BASE / name
    before = path.read_bytes()
    assert stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(path.lstat().st_mode) == 0o644
    assert pin(before)['git_blob'] == oid and pin(before) == base_manifest[name]
    assert (PREPARED / name).read_bytes() == before
    write(HERE / 'originals' / name, before)
    source[name] = before.decode()

checker = source['tools/check_hia_core_only.py']
marker = "\n\ndef _is_active_json_source(path, relative):\n"
checker = single(checker, marker, '''

# Optional standalone components have a separate explicit profile domain.
# These paths still receive complete program verification; installation and
# source headers do not grant profile authority or expand the worker profile.
OPTIONAL_SOURCE_PROFILES = {
    'examples/hia_bootstrap/native_file_roundtrip.hepta': 'hepta.hia.linux-file-roundtrip.v2',
}


def _is_active_json_source(path, relative):
''')
checker = single(checker,
    '            profile = EXPLICIT_SOURCE_PROFILES.get(relative.as_posix())\n',
    '            profile = EXPLICIT_SOURCE_PROFILES.get(relative.as_posix())\n'
    '            if profile is None:\n'
    '                profile = OPTIONAL_SOURCE_PROFILES.get(relative.as_posix())\n')

portable = source['tests/hia_linux_file_roundtrip_portable.py']
portable = single(portable,
    '    from hepta.hia_agent_contract import NATIVE_SOURCE_FILES, ENTRY_BUILD_FILES\n',
    '''    from hepta.hia_agent_contract import (
        DISCOVERY_FILES, NATIVE_SOURCE_FILES, SOURCE_BUILD_FILES, COMPILER_BUILD_FILES,
        PUBLICATION_BUILD_FILES, BACKEND_BUILD_FILES, EMITTER_BUILD_FILES,
        BYTE_WRAPPER_BUILD_FILES, MACHINE_OBJECT_BUILD_FILES,
        EXECUTION_OBSERVATION_BUILD_FILES, CONTINUATION_BUILD_FILES, ENTRY_BUILD_FILES,
    )
    resources = (tuple('docs/' + name for name in DISCOVERY_FILES)
        + NATIVE_SOURCE_FILES + SOURCE_BUILD_FILES + COMPILER_BUILD_FILES
        + PUBLICATION_BUILD_FILES + BACKEND_BUILD_FILES + EMITTER_BUILD_FILES
        + BYTE_WRAPPER_BUILD_FILES + MACHINE_OBJECT_BUILD_FILES
        + EXECUTION_OBSERVATION_BUILD_FILES + CONTINUATION_BUILD_FILES + ENTRY_BUILD_FILES)
''')
portable = single(portable, '    return RESOURCES\n',
    "    require(resources == RESOURCES, 'explicit whole-package resource roles differ')\n"
    '    return resources\n')
after = {'tools/check_hia_core_only.py': checker,
         'tests/hia_linux_file_roundtrip_portable.py': portable}
for name, text in after.items():
    write(HERE / 'source' / name, text.encode())
    diff = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(source[name].splitlines(keepends=True), text.splitlines(keepends=True),
                                     fromfile='before/' + name, tofile='after/' + name))
    write(HERE / 'diffs' / (name.replace('/', '__') + '.diff'), diff.encode())
assert not (BASE / NEW).exists()
after[NEW] = (HERE / 'source' / NEW).read_text()

# Mechanical inverse: the new table and single fallback are the entire checker change.
before_ast, after_ast = parse(source['tools/check_hia_core_only.py']), parse(checker)
assert dump_ast(assignment(before_ast, 'EXPLICIT_SOURCE_PROFILES')) == dump_ast(assignment(after_ast, 'EXPLICIT_SOURCE_PROFILES'))
optional = assignment(after_ast, 'OPTIONAL_SOURCE_PROFILES')
assert ast.literal_eval(optional.value) == {'examples/hia_bootstrap/native_file_roundtrip.hepta': 'hepta.hia.linux-file-roundtrip.v2'}
assert set(ast.literal_eval(optional.value)).isdisjoint(ast.literal_eval(assignment(before_ast, 'EXPLICIT_SOURCE_PROFILES').value))
inverse = copy.deepcopy(after_ast)
inverse.body.remove(assignment(inverse, 'OPTIONAL_SOURCE_PROFILES'))
fallback = ast.parse('if profile is None:\n    profile = OPTIONAL_SOURCE_PROFILES.get(relative.as_posix())\n').body[0]
removed = 0
for node in ast.walk(inverse):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Try):
        matched = [n for n in node.body if dump_ast(n) == dump_ast(fallback)]
        for n in matched:
            node.body.remove(n)
            removed += 1
assert removed == 1 and dump_ast(inverse) == dump_ast(before_ast)

# Every original portable definition except the resource constructor is identical.
portable_before, portable_after = parse(source['tests/hia_linux_file_roundtrip_portable.py']), parse(portable)
inverse = copy.deepcopy(portable_after)
index = inverse.body.index(function(inverse, 'default_resources'))
inverse.body[index] = copy.deepcopy(function(portable_before, 'default_resources'))
assert dump_ast(inverse) == dump_ast(portable_before)
old_guard = function(portable_before, 'default_resources').body[2]
new_body = function(portable_after, 'default_resources').body
assert sum(dump_ast(node) == dump_ast(old_guard) for node in new_body) == 1
contract = parse((BASE / 'hepta/hia_agent_contract.py').read_text())
needed = {target.id for node in contract.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
          for target in node.targets if isinstance(target, ast.Name)
          and (target.id.endswith('_BUILD_FILES') or target.id in ('DISCOVERY_FILES', 'NATIVE_SOURCE_FILES'))}
assert needed == set(ROLE_NAMES)
groups = {name: ast.literal_eval(assignment(contract, name).value) for name in ROLE_NAMES}
resources = tuple('docs/' + name for name in groups['DISCOVERY_FILES']) + tuple(
    path for name in ROLE_NAMES[1:] for path in groups[name])
assert len(resources) == len(set(resources)) == 210
assert len(groups['NATIVE_SOURCE_FILES']) == 92 and len(groups['ENTRY_BUILD_FILES']) == 19
new_resource_node = next(n for n in new_body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign))
used_names = [n.id for n in ast.walk(new_resource_node.value) if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id in needed]
assert set(used_names) == needed and len(used_names) == 12
reference_resources = assignment(parse((BASE / 'tests/test_hia_agent_installed_resources.py').read_text()), 'RESOURCES').value

def resource_expression(node, local=None):
    local = {} if local is None else local
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name): return local[node.id] if node.id in local else groups[node.id]
    if isinstance(node, ast.Constant): return node.value
    if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp) and isinstance(node.op, ast.Add):
        return resource_expression(node.left, local) + resource_expression(node.right, local)
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == 'tuple' and not node.keywords and len(node.args) == 1:
        return tuple(resource_expression(node.args[0], local))
    if isinstance(node, ast.GeneratorExp) and len(node.generators) == 1:
        gen = node.generators[0]
        assert isinstance(gen.target, ast.Name) and not gen.ifs and gen.is_async == 0
        return tuple(resource_expression(node.elt, {**local, gen.target.id: value})
                     for value in resource_expression(gen.iter, local))
    raise AssertionError(ast.dump(node))
assert resource_expression(new_resource_node.value) == resource_expression(reference_resources) == resources
assert set(resources).isdisjoint(ast.literal_eval(assignment(parse((BASE/'hepta/hia_linux_file_roundtrip.py').read_text()), 'PROFILE_SOURCE_FILES').value))

related = {}
for name in RELATED:
    raw = (BASE / name).read_bytes()
    assert pin(raw) == base_manifest[name]
    related[name] = {**pin(raw), 'prepared_bytes_equal': (PREPARED / name).read_bytes() == raw,
                     'included_in_changed_files': False}

new_tree = parse(after[NEW])
classes = [n for n in new_tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef)]
assert len(classes) == 1 and classes[0].name == 'RoundtripSourceRoleTests'
methods = [n.name for n in classes[0].body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith('test_')]
assert len(methods) == 3
ids = ['tests.test_hia_roundtrip_source_roles.RoundtripSourceRoleTests.' + name for name in sorted(methods)]
final_manifest = copy.deepcopy(base_manifest)
files = {}
for name, text in after.items():
    before_raw = source[name].encode() if name in source else None
    raw = text.encode()
    mode = stat.S_IMODE((HERE/'source'/name).lstat().st_mode)
    assert mode == 0o644
    ast.parse(raw, filename=name)
    final_manifest[name] = pin(raw)
    files[name] = {'before': None if before_raw is None else {**pin(before_raw), 'text': before_raw.decode()},
                   'after': {**pin(raw), 'text': text}}
final_tree = tree_id(final_manifest)
report = {
    'schema': 'hepta.r19.core-portable-source-repairs.v1',
    'status': 'AUTHORED_STATIC_CHECKED_NOT_PRODUCT_EXECUTED',
    'formal_original': {'run': 43544318748, 'job': 132291881222, 'source_tree': BASE_TREE,
                        'source_files': 3175, 'tests': 1411, 'passed': 1407, 'failures': 3, 'errors': 1},
    'base_source': str(BASE), 'base_manifest': str(BASE.parent/'CANDIDATE-MANIFEST.json'),
    'base_tree_recomputed': BASE_TREE, 'after_tree_derived_from_full_manifest': final_tree,
    'after_files': len(final_manifest), 'changed_paths': sorted(after),
    'full_source_materialized': False, 'overlay_only': True,
    'checker_inverse_ast_exact': True, 'old_explicit_profile_table_ast_unchanged': True,
    'optional_exact_profile': ast.literal_eval(optional.value),
    'portable_all_other_definitions_ast_unchanged': True, 'portable_original_guard_ast_unchanged': True,
    'default_resource_roles': list(ROLE_NAMES), 'default_resource_count': 210,
    'native_resource_count': 92, 'entry_resource_count': 19,
    'resource_order_exact_original_RESOURCES': True,
    'optional_resource_membership_does_not_expand_worker_roles': True,
    'retained_related_files': related, 'new_selector': 'tests.test_hia_roundtrip_source_roles.RoundtripSourceRoleTests',
    'new_test_ids_unittest_order': ids, 'new_test_ids_author_order': [ids[0].rsplit('.',1)[0] + '.' + name for name in methods],
    'product_tests_executed': 0, 'native_compiles': 0, 'vm_executions': 0,
    'matching_current_cold': False, 'whole_native': False,
    'limits_and_oracles_changed': False, 'fixed_original_tests_edited': [],
    'pending_validation': 'Root-coordinated focused run of original classes plus new three Source methods; no qualification inferred from AST.'}
dump(HERE/'STATIC-REPORT.json', report)
dump(HERE/'SOURCE-DELTA.json', {'schema':'hepta.exact-source-delta.v1', 'base_tree':BASE_TREE,
                              'after_tree':final_tree, 'base_files':3175, 'after_files':len(final_manifest),
                              'status':report['status'], 'files':files})
dump(HERE/'AFTER-MANIFEST.json', final_manifest)
print(json.dumps({'status':report['status'],'after_tree':final_tree,'after_files':len(final_manifest),
                  'files':{name:row['after']|{'text':'[complete text retained in SOURCE-DELTA]'} for name,row in files.items()},
                  'new_test_ids':ids},sort_keys=True))

def write(path, raw):

readme='''# R19 Core and portable resource repair candidate

This is an authored, statically checked successor to the exact formal R19 source
tree d15d7a476fc3f711b2729236e84b7a9573da7a3d. The original 1,411-test run remains
1407 PASS / 3 FAIL / 1 ERROR. No product test, native compile, VM, or cold run has
been executed for this successor.

The Core-only scanner retains its original eight-entry explicit profile table.
The new optional table maps only native_file_roundtrip.hepta to the already
implemented roundtrip.v2 verifier. Every source still receives complete program
verification; an unregistered path receives ordinary Core verification.

The portable fixture constructs its default resource tuple from all twelve real
production roles and checks ordered equality with the original RESOURCES tuple.
The original 210-resource / 92-native / 19-entry, uniqueness and optional-disjoint
guards remain unchanged. The actual copy, wheel and readback paths consume this
constructor. All other portable definitions and original test methods remain
unchanged.

Three new Source controls are authored for real profile dispatch in assembly and
JSON, invalid effects and unregistered paths, and all twelve real role dependencies.
The exact IDs and pending original classes are in SPEC.json. Their execution is
pending a Root-coordinated focused run.

SOURCE-DELTA.json contains full before/after text for the two changed files and
the complete new test file. Source-file Git hashes in the packet are computed
identities; the packet preserves their bytes without claiming each source blob
has independently been posted. Only three source paths are materialized in this
overlay; the full successor tree is derived from the retained complete original
manifest. All original source/assets/tests and budgets remain frozen.
'''
write(HERE/'handoff/README.md',readme.encode())
paths={
    'source/SOURCE-DELTA.json':HERE/'SOURCE-DELTA.json',
    'source/STATIC-REPORT.json':HERE/'STATIC-REPORT.json',
    'source/SPEC.json':HERE/'handoff/SPEC.json',

    'original/ORIGINAL-FAILURES.json':HERE/'handoff/ORIGINAL-FAILURES.json',
    'README.md':HERE/'handoff/README.md',
}
rows=[]
for index,(name,path) in enumerate(paths.items()):
    raw=path.read_bytes();rows.append({'name':f'leaf-{index:02d}', 'path':name,

json_file(HERE/'handoff/PUBLISH-PLAN.json',rows)

                  'bytes':sum(row['bytes'] for row in rows),'entries':rows},sort_keys=True))
